Listopia > Best American History Books
Books about the history of the United States. Non-fiction only, please. Biographies of generals, presidents, activists, etc. are fine, but celebrity bios, even celebrities who lived in turbulent times, will be removed. To be considered History and not Current Events, books must focus on events that occurred at least 50 years ago. See also: Best 19th Century American (U.S.) History - 3.7 Stars and Up Best 20th Century American (U.S.) History - 3.7 Stars and Up
